On Jun 4, 4:52 pm, XZealot <xzea...@cox.net> wrote:
> When I try to update the database I get a corruption error, can anyone
> explain this to me?

The CSV file that has been uploaded to the White Wolf website is
wrong. It seems to contain a copy of the actual card text web pages
and not just the CSV files. Inside of the zip file are the actual
files required by Ardb. There is still a problem though as only the
library cards have been updated. It does not contain the new crypt
cards. As soon as the correct files have been upload by White Wolf
you will be able to update Ardb.

Graham.
